request.report: Rewrote bench/spec_summarize.py with both advisor fixes: (1) per-phase VRAM deltas from vram.txt (A-prod now shows +1/+1/+1/-1 MiB, not one arm-wide median), (2) first-divergence character indices for the off dual-vs-single control mismatches in both summary.md and summary.json. Added explicit per-phase VRAM label and threshold values to the rule rows, and full infra deploy path (serving/candidates/bonsai-2-27b.ngram.yaml + infra request) that only fires if all 6 rules pass. Sandbox test: rules 2/3/5 FAIL, 1/4/6 PASS → no-deploy; all numbers recompute from requests.jsonl.
request.why: Regenerate bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/{summary.md,summary.json,deploy.json} on the host where the gitignored replay outputs exist, so first-divergence indices for control and arm mismatches are resolved and the summary tables are final for the no-deploy decision.
